extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.65[CR]- Reuse verified unchanged private Chrome runtime files instead of repeating the full runtime hash scan on every playback.[CR]- Signal native helper shutdown independently of media traffic, wake cancelled waits and bound helper exit before owned-job cleanup.[CR]- Avoid redundant Windows output-protection requests while checking real protection and retaining the measured HDCP 2.2 capability for HD.[CR]- Record runtime verification work, adapter revision, output-protection release and native shutdown timings in the complete diagnostics report.[CR]- Retain automatic pinned Google runtime download and all accumulated regional, sign-in, Watchlist, Back, resume, artwork and title fixes.

extension.description: ScottyWins Testing installs and updates Smooth Prime builds from the PrimeScene testing branch on Kodi 21. It does not publish the public channel.
extension.news: 1.0.1[CR]- Smooth Prime test packages download from GitHub Release assets so each version has a download count. The add-on index, icons, and fanart stay on this site.
